---
description: "Use when implementing code changes in this repository. Enforce minimal modifications only, preserving existing styles, behaviors, and functionality not directly related to the request."
name: "Minimal Change Policy"
applyTo: "**/*.py"
---
# Minimal Change Policy

- Make the smallest possible code change that satisfies the request.
- Do not alter styles, designs, behavior, or functionality outside the requested scope.
- Preserve existing code structure and patterns unless a change is strictly necessary.
- If the requested change is ambiguous or requires broader refactoring, ask before proceeding.
